cast_dialogue.linea: People take 'who', things take 'which'... and places take 'where'. A library is a place WHERE stories live.
A library is a place where you can read and study in silence.
A stadium is a place where people watch sports. London has amazing stadiums!
My favorite place is the park where I play with my friends.
The market where I buy my vegetables is a place where everybody knows my name.

banco_oraciones.oracion: A library is a place where you can read.
A hospital is a place where doctors work.
This is the park where I play.
A beach is a place where people swim and relax.
This isn't the café where we met.
A museum isn't a place where you can run.
That isn't the hotel where they stayed.
Is this the shop where you bought it?
Is there a place where you feel happy?
Is a zoo a place where you see animals? Yes, it is.
Is this the restaurant where we ate? No, it isn't.
Is a spa a place where you relax? Yes, it is.

inicio.definicion_pragmatica: For places, use 'where' in relative clauses: 'A park is a place where children play.' The trio is complete: people = who, things = which, places = where.

filas: A doctor is a person who helps people.
A phone is a device which connects people.
A beach is a place where people relax.

ejercicios.pregunta: A library is a place ___ you can read.
A ___ is a place where you see animals.
This is the café ___ we met for the first time.

ejercicios.afirmacion: For places, we use 'where' in relative clauses.
We say 'a place who you can relax'.

ejercicios.texto: A stadium is a place ___ people watch sports.
A ___ is a place where you buy fresh food. (place)

ejercicios.respuesta: A beach is a place where people relax.

ejercicios.texto_con_error: A museum is a place which you see art.
ejercicios.respuesta: A museum is a place where you see art.

ejercicios.oracion_base: You can watch movies in a cinema.
ejercicios.instruccion: Define the place with 'a place where'.
ejercicios.respuesta: A cinema is a place where you can watch movies.

ejercicios.oracion_base: This is the shop where you bought it.
ejercicios.respuesta: Is this the shop where you bought it?

ejercicios.pregunta: Describe your favorite place. (Use 'a place where'.)
ejercicios.respuesta: My favorite place is the park where I walk my dog.

guion: Ben: What is your favorite place in the city, Sofía?
Sofía: The library! It's a place where I can think in silence.
Ben: Nice. Mine is the stadium where I watch football.
Sofía: And Kenji's favorite place is the amusement park, right?
Ben: Ha! Yes. And Abuela Carmen loves the market where everybody knows her.
Sofía: Every person has a special place.

reading.texto: My city has a place for everyone. The library is a place where students read in silence, and the stadium is where fans watch football on Sundays. The market is a place where my grandmother buys fresh vegetables, and the amusement park is where children scream with joy. My favorite place is the beach where my family swims in summer. Every place has its own magic.

preguntas.afirmacion: Fans watch football at the stadium.
Her grandmother buys vegetables at the supermarket.
Her family swims at the beach in summer.
